_comment: The additional cost (banish 3 random cards from your graveyard) gates play, so it is a cost and not an on-play effect. The payoff is conditional on a 6+ power card having been banished this way, which the banish turn events cannot express (they record identity, not power), so the +{p} is granted unconditionally on the next attack action — MORE generous than printed. Called out because it is the wrong direction for an approximation. The banish is also player-chosen rather than RANDOM: the cost has no random mode, and inventing a `random` flag it does not read would be silently dropped anyway.
